texto: You've lived the same Tuesday four times. Same rain. Same bus. Same misspelled coffee cup.
Then the girl behind you in line looks at the cup and whispers, "Again."
That word was never in the script.
You follow her into the rain. She turns around and says, "You're the one who keeps buying the lottery ticket. I've watched you do it four times."
She's been stuck here for eleven days.
And she thinks something is making it happen.
